analysis.headline: Shares Your Data for Marketing
analysis.quote: Some Mozilla.org pages use clear GIFs which communicate with DoubleClick to understand the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns; you can control personalized ads from DoubleClick in Google’s ad settings (you will be prompted to sign into your Google account).

analysis.headline: Many Third-Parties Process Your Data
analysis.quote: We use Greenhouse to handle employment and intern applications, and Fluxx.io to handle fellowship and MOSS grant applications.

analysis.headline: Your Contributions May Be Public
analysis.quote: If you contribute to Bugzilla, or our code bases, then your email address and possibly your name will be publicly available to all internet users.

analysis.headline: Your Feedback May Be Public
analysis.quote: Please minimize the personal information you choose to share on these forums because your comments may be accessible to the public.

analysis.headline: Uses Google Analytics on Your Device
analysis.quote: Google Analytics, which places a cookie on your device, to obtain metrics on how users engage with our websites.

analysis.headline: Google reCAPTCHA Monitors Your Activity
analysis.quote: Mozilla has implemented third-party technology, Google’s Invisible reCAPTCHA, that operates in the background on some of our websites in order to identify fraudulent activity.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Payment Records 10 Years
analysis.quote: We use Braze, Salesforce, Fundraise Up and Campaign Monitor to email receipts and store records, which are retained for 10 years from the date of last payment.

analysis.headline: Respects Your Do Not Track
analysis.quote: In addition, if you have configured your browser to send a “Do Not Track” signal when accessing our websites, Mozilla will not utilize any of the tools described in the Metrics section.
